description: Adds the contacts you picked to a campaign, as Add to campaign on the Contacts page does: each is checked against the campaign's safety rules and the answer names who was added, who was skipped and why. preview: true writes nothing and shows what would happen; use a new idempotency_key for the real add (the same one with different arguments is refused). A step due today is drafted, never sent. confirmOverCap: true only when your person accepts going over today's cap. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat adds nobody twice.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: add_contacts_to_campaign
title: Add chosen contacts to a campaign
